title: House Dance For Beginners- The Jack and Reverse Jack

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor uses an encouraging, step-by-step breakdown approach starting from basic movements to practicing with music. She explains body mechanics clearly and demonstrates variations from different angles.

lesson_structure.note: Explanation of what the jack is
Breakdown of the foundational jack step
Practicing the jack with music at various tempos
Breakdown of the reverse jack step
Practicing the reverse jack with music at various tempos
Review of both jack and reverse jack

metaphors: knees are waving with the music

steps_taught.name: The Jack
steps_taught.description: Foundational house groove starting with loose knees moving in a circular rhythm.

steps_taught.name: The Reverse Jack
steps_taught.description: House groove starting by dropping knees down and rolling the body up.

what_works: Demonstrations from front and side angles

quotes.text: To me, the jack is the groove or the foundation of house technique.
I like to kind of think of it moving in a circular motion.
Dig down into the earth, down and up.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor demonstrates the jack step while explaining knee movement facing the camera

extraction.distinctive_method: Breaking down groove foundations by isolating knee and torso movement directions before adding music.
